name: Low-Carb Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy Skillet

Distinct from catalog turkey-meatballs-cream-sauce-skillet and swedish-meatball-potato-bowls (cream/Swedish sauce, meatball form), so those are NOT collisions.
